text: Heather Langenkamp, the actress who played Nancy in the Nightmare on Elm Street films, lives in Los Angeles with her husband Chase and young son Dylan. When a new sequel is proposed, [Freddy's claws start reaching out of the films|origin|stories come true]: an obsessed caller recites his rhyme, Chase is slashed at the wheel, and [Dylan grows terrified of sleep|who_suffers|young children]. Wes Craven explains that the films held an ancient entity captive, and his new script [records everything Heather does before she does it|rules|reality comes apart].
